title: A Prospective Study of a New Immunochemical Fecal Occult Blood Test in U.S. Veteran Patients Undergoing Colonoscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of our study is to evaluate the diagnostic validity of a new immunofecal occult blood test (IFOBT) (Teco Diagnostics) in U.S. veterans and to compare it with the guaiac based FOBT.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients (men or women) that are \>18 years of age undergoing colonoscopy for a variety of indications (bleeding, diarrhea, weight loss, anemia, abdominal pain, etc)

Exclusion Criteria:

* concurrent hospitalization
* visible rectal bleeding
* known diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease
* hematuria
* menstruation at the time of obtaining a stool specimen and performing the tests
* inability to prepare the 3 different IFOBT or 3 different FOBT kits
